title: Pinned SDK/harness export-family inventory
native_observation: Mixed historical and refreshed observations. The eight rows named in native_observation_refresh retain their stated dates; tool_registry_and_direct_calls was additionally reconciled after accepted generation18/live-provider50, and byte_storage_and_search_catalog after S370. Unchanged rows and the initial native catalog/planning slices are not current absence/completion measures.
inventory_scope: Feature families reachable through pinned public package entrypoints and importable public Python modules. This is not a complete symbol-by-symbol ABI baseline or an assertion that names imply behavioral parity.
validation: Read-only source inspection plus JSON/reference validation only; no builds, tests, live providers, network requests, source commits or runtime parity checks were performed for this audit.

status_definitions.absent: No native implementation of the feature family was found.
status_definitions.partial: A related native capability exists with named behavioral or surface gaps.
status_definitions.implemented_subset: A substantive native implementation exists; remaining integration/extension gaps are still listed.
status_definitions.not_a_verified_pinned_sdk_export: Not established as an SDK/harness parity requirement from the inspected pinned exports.

priority_definition: 1 = foundational or directly blocks common default harness behavior; 2 = substantial common surface/catalog; 3 = language-specific or optional expansion. These are implementation priorities, not severity scores or completion percentages.

remaining: ITool and IRichTool return only final values; no native streaming tool capability or ToolStreamUpdateEvent.
MCP protocol progress callback availability does not provide agent-loop tool-stream parity.
intentional_or_upstream_differences: TS async generators return a final ToolResultBlock separately from yielded progress; a C# async enumerable needs an explicit terminal-result representation or separate completion contract.

remaining: FunctionTool.Create<T> deserializes an explicitly supplied JSON schema; it does not generate schemas or descriptions from methods/types.
No attribute/delegate reflection binding equivalent to Python signature/docstring/Pydantic or TS Zod conversion.
intentional_or_upstream_differences: Python decorators and TS Zod schemas are language integrations, not libraries to transplant into C#.

remaining: Foreign-language source watching, private dependency graph reload, outer Harness delegation/server and Bidi catalog refresh, automatic reconnect and resource unloading remain separate contracts.

Declared-file managed root generations and optional live Agent owner-batch publication now exist as bounded native capabilities. The latest composed Main still needs an exact-source combined matrix; their presence is not exhaustive cross-language registry parity.
intentional_or_upstream_differences: Native configuration resolves explicit CLR bindings rather than evaluating arbitrary Python/TypeScript module code.
feature_groups.implemented_observation: Native direct calls, atomic application registration/replacement/removal, provider consumer lifecycle, frozen spec filtering and trusted managed assembly exports exist. Declared-file root-image generations preserve old exports, and optional IToolProviderUpdates supplies atomically validated live owner snapshots with retained admitted background bindings and independent MCP consumer drains. Fixed declared managed roots now have an opt-in watched IToolProviderUpdates factory with independent observer drains, admission receipts and retained borrowed old tools.

proposed_native_union_policy.status: Design proposal for unimplemented families; not implemented public API or a parity claim.
proposed_native_union_policy.principle: Include the native capability union where useful. Expose explicit compatibility options for material upstream semantic conflicts. Document each native default, its source baseline, and any deliberate safety difference.

scheduling.default: ReadyNodes (TS individual readiness with bounded concurrency)

agentRevisitState.optional: Retain (Python default), with explicit reset-on-revisit support

graph.cancellation: Native cooperative cancellation must release all active owned nodes; nested timeout policy must be explicit rather than inferred from either language.

contextTransfer.optional: ExplicitSharedContext (Python capability), separately owned from caller invocation state

limitOutcome.default: Throw for step limit (TS); FailedResult for repetitive handoff (shared soft stop)

proposed_native_union_policy.tools: C# optional capabilities and schema generators preserve concepts, validation and observability; they do not reproduce decorators, Zod or Pydantic as foreign runtime dependencies.
proposed_native_union_policy.providerAndHostCatalog: Common native transports first; optional packages for union providers/server hosts. Clearly identify language SDK bridges for which a native transport is an alternative, not literal package parity.
retainedNativeSafety: Never silently replay escaped streamed output or completed tool side effects.
Preserve cancellation, caller ownership, primary errors and bounded cleanup.
Refuse invalid or expanding context transformations even where a pinned source implementation accepts them.
proposed_native_union_policy.defaultSelectionNote: TypeScript defaults are proposed for new graph/swarm conflicts to provide one coherent baseline. Python alternatives remain explicit acceptance requirements for the inclusive union. Parent and maintainer API review may revise the proposal before implementation.
